glossary.definition: The personal notebook every Explorer keeps to record observations, evidence and reflections throughout an expedition.
A permanent, cross-campaign record of an Explorer's reflections and discoveries.
An optional, curiosity-driven investigation that never blocks mission completion.
The role a parent plays during a campaign — supporting logistics and encouragement, not teaching content directly.
The abandoned research station at the centre of Campaign 01.
The international organisation the learner joins, devoted to exploration, investigation and scientific discovery.

organisations.name: Explorer Academy
organisations.description: An international organisation devoted to exploration, investigation and scientific discovery. Values curiosity, evidence, collaboration, observation, integrity and persistence.

organisations.name: The Expedition Network
organisations.description: Explorer Academy's network of research stations across diverse environments, each investigating a particular scientific or engineering domain. Outpost Echo is one dormant station in this network.
